primitives.name: Spalding Offense Selection
primitives.verbatim_quote: The offended side may elect whether it will put the ball in play on its opponents' 35-yard line or whether the offending side shall put the ball in play on its own 15-yard line.
primitives.assumptions: Offense chooses between two fixed yard lines based on liability threshold.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Discrete binary choice collapses to zero-probability singularity under forced line assignment.

layer2.mapping: Maps to conformal prediction regions in GSI for defensive positioning; also maps to discrete state transitions in GSE for down-and-distance calculations.
layer2.telemetry: Observed field position distributions conditional on foul type

primitives.name: Time Calling Principle
primitives.verbatim_quote: Time shall not be called for the end of a period until the ball is dead, but in case of a touchdown the try-at-goal shall be allowed.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_{\\text{call}}': 'time calling instant (seconds)', 'T_{\\text{dead}}': 'ball death time (seconds)', '\\delta(x)': 'Kronecker delta function (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Game clock halts only at defined dead-ball events, with optional post-touchdown extension.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Temporal singularity occurs at hard deadline crossing, triggering immediate stoppage.

layer2.mapping: Maps to Bayesian stopping rules in GSI for optimal halftime allocation; also maps to temporal state machines in GSE for quarter boundary transitions.
layer2.telemetry: Distribution of elapsed time between dead balls and official whistle

primitives.name: Fair Catch Extension
primitives.verbatim_quote: In case of a fair catch, made after time has expired, the kick shall be allowed and time shall be called when the ball is next declared dead.
primitives.assumptions: Post-expiry catches grant a single, finite continuation period.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Event-triggered temporal resumption occurs only upon re-establishing dead-ball state.

layer2.mapping: Maps to sequential testing frameworks in GSI for extended play verifications; also maps to event-driven state transitions in GSE for kick sequence management.
layer2.telemetry: Conditional probability of fair catch given remaining game clock bin

primitives.name: Final Score Decider
primitives.verbatim_quote: The game shall be decided by the final score at the end of the four periods.
primitives.assumptions: Outcome determined solely by total points accumulated before hard deadline.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Discrete score summation collapses to terminal value at fixed quartile boundary.

layer2.mapping: Maps to empirical distribution aggregation in GSI for final outcome predictions; also maps to terminal state evaluation in GSE for game-state classification.
layer2.telemetry: Historical win/loss outcomes conditioned on fourth-quarter score differential
